mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.description, i.price, i.original_price, i.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.icon AS category_icon, i.seller_id, u.nickname AS seller_nickname, u.avatar AS seller_avatar, i.image_url, i.item_condition, i.location, i.status, i.view_count, i.created_at FROM t_favorite f JOIN t_item i ON i.id = f.item_id LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = i.seller_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
